offlineReview.method: Read retained JSONL, verify source hash, compare original tool wording with compacted summary and timestamps. No model calls.
expected: An unknown receipt must not be summarized as permission to rename and retry.
Exact active tool entry paths should remain recoverable after compaction.
offlineReview.observed: Both expectations are violated in the retained summary.
offlineReview.causalityLimit: The demonstrated renamed retry happened before compaction. Compaction did not cause that earlier retry.
